why: Counts the bare `blockedByLoaded` flag instead of pairing it with GitHub's own count -- which is exactly what the first version of this file did. `enrichOpenIssueRelationships` only reads blockers when the dependency summary is above zero or the issue is `agent-ready`/`priority:now`, so an ordinary unblocked issue carries `blockedByLoaded: false` too. Under the mutation the published map reports every unblocked issue as a hole in the data, burying the issues whose blockers really are unknown. The gap is not hypothetical: the mutation is the bug this file shipped in its first draft, and the named test is what caught it.
killedBy: buildSnapshot counts each way the graph is incomplete, against the issue population
